assumptions: The 32 local read slices and sector-sharing HV isolation are a custom reference layout, not a claim about W25Q128JV internal architecture.
Read timing is transferred from NOR-01 complete binary random access to the specified locally widened slices, with explicit 4096 SA resources; no analog current matching is assumed.

Each local 256-Byte page retains the NOR-02 complete binary program service and each 4KB sector retains its complete erase service after partitioning. This transfer requires physical implementation validation.
The source media voltages, high-voltage circuitry and original processes are retained as media constraints; only common digital periphery uses the 28nm reference.
Three paired scenarios combine compatible binary state budgets, not the fastest claims of one measured chip or statistically correlated PVT corners.
No independent read or write replicas, spare-matrix swapping, read/write overlap, native block erase substitution, or wear-leveling speedup is assumed.
